content:
Overview

Arlon is a city in Luxembourg with a population of 30,000. The capital of Belgian Luxembourg, a bilingual (French-German) city near the Grand Duchy border with a charming historic center and Roman museum. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
